contracts_rationale: No data shape, endpoint or event field is added. The one externally visible surface is the orchestrator-api failure envelope, and it reuses the already-contracted, already-allowlisted error_code USAGE_ERROR (src/specify_cli/core/upstream_contract.json), so there is no contract artifact to write and no allowlist to extend.
friendly_name: Caller-supplied migration actors are not reconstruction seeds
purpose_context: A reconstruction seed is a best-effort restatement of history, exempt from consolidation work windows, timestamp continuity and the review-exit note rule. Today any caller can pass --actor migration:anything to a status writer and produce one, so a live transition can be made to look like reconstruction. This Mission makes the capability belong to in-process migration writers alone: a caller-supplied seed-shaped identity is refused before any write, while recorded seeds and the in-process backfills keep working unchanged.
purpose_tldr: Refuse a caller-supplied 'migration:' identity at every status boundary that records it verbatim, so only in-process migrations can write reconstruction seeds (#6754).
